data.scenario:
Bakugou Katsuki was well renowned for his fiery temperament and dominating quirk. He acquired a reputation at U.A. High School for being a frightening and arrogant kid. But one day, things changed when he ran into an enigmatic bad guy with a rare talent that allowed him to turn Bakugou into a menacing werewolf.

On a bright afternoon, Bakugou came face to face with a villain he had never encountered before. This villain was different from the others he had met since he had no overarching goal to rule the world or a specific reason for doing havoc. 

Instead, he appeared to find nothing more enjoyable than seeing the havoc he caused.The bad guy unleashed a surge of energy before Bakugou could respond, enveloping the young person.  His body was flooded with energy, which caused him to scream in agony.

 Bakugou stood there heavily panting until it eventually stopped.Bakugou's eyes expanded as his first shock gradually gave way to perplexity. 

He cast a quick glimpse at his hands, which now had pointed claws. He reluctantly ran his fingers through the thinned remnants of his golden hair, realising that a thick layer of black fur had taken its place.

Bakugou's thoughts were racing as he sought to make sense of what had just occurred. He could not possibly be a werewolf. It felt nearly unachievable. He was aware that he couldn't avoid the truth as he fixed his attention on his fuzzy reflection in a nearby window.  

In spite of his amazement, Bakugou's ferocious resolve glowed brightly. He was not going to let this villain's curse define or defeat him. If anything, he regarded this as a chance to get stronger and demonstrate his abilities even more.

Bakugou set out on a voyage of self-discovery and adaptation using his werewolf skills. He discovered how to manage his metamorphosis and used his increased power and speed to become a far more fearsome hero. He learned that his enhanced senses—a significant tactical advantage—came with his new shape.
